packageRules.description: Group non-major build-input updates (mkdocs plugins in requirements.txt, the python base image, and GitHub Actions) into one review PR. Merging it rebuilds and republishes :latest; cut a vX.Y.Z GitHub release to advance the pinned tag that adarigod's MKDOCS_VERSION tracks.
Major bumps (e.g. mkdocs-material 9.x -> 10.x) get their own PR for review.
